finding: PRODUCTIVE_CAP must remain an empirical completion envelope, whereas SOFT_CUTOFF is a control-policy choice. Under P3/P4 the latest admissible task start is task-size-dependent: hard_cap - reserve - estimated_task_duration. A scalar SOFT_CUTOFF should be retained only as a conservative fallback/simple-policy comparator.
decision_value: Prevents Phase A survival results from prematurely hard-coding a fixed latest-start threshold and preserves a fair Phase C comparison between P1/P2 and P3/P4.
